definitions.explanation: A system of government in which power rests with the people, who rule directly or through elected representatives; the institution itself, as opposed to the ideal or principle.

examples.japanese: {民主制|みんしゅせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧
examples.english: a country with a democratic system

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{民主制|みんしゅせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: Democracy was born in ancient Greece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間接|かんせつ}→間接：00180_kansetsu⟧{民主制|みんしゅせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: In indirect democracy, representatives chosen by the people govern.

notes:
Belongs to the set of words for forms of government ending in ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: ⟦{君主制|くんしゅせい}→君主制：21776_kunshusei⟧ (monarchy), ⟦{共和制|きょうわせい}→共和制：22243_kyouwasei⟧ (republic), ⟦{独裁制|どくさいせい}→独裁制：21777_dokusaisei⟧ (dictatorship).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{民主制|みんしゅせい}: direct democracy
- ⟦{間接|かんせつ}→間接：00180_kansetsu⟧{民主制|みんしゅせい}: indirect (representative) democracy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧: democracy as an ideal or principle; the everyday word
- {民主制|みんしゅせい}: the system of government, used in political science and history
